cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. The landing lists Development and does not show Query 1. A click on Development shows host dev-db.internal.acme.io and database acme_dev. Connect finishes on Query 1 in catalog acme_prod › public, with status ✓ Connected to Development and the empty editor placeholder Type SQL. The status is not Loading schema. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; click Development; click Connect
cases.return_path: the workbench is already Query 1; Ctrl+Q exits

cases.disposition_reason: On Development, the Query 1 editor receives SELECT 1 AS t03_running_marker. Development Safe Mode is Silent, so this read does not open an Execute confirm. Ctrl+R draws a running line ending in Esc cancels, and Cancelled is absent. A second Ctrl+R sets status Already running · Esc cancels and leaves that same running line, with no result tab and no Query 2. Esc then shows one result tab Cancelled, the result line Cancelled · nothing was recorded, and the empty state titled Cancelled with hint The statement was stopped before it finished; nothing was recorded. The statement stays in the editor. The marker is not a result row. The 120×40 frame is that cancelled result. The 80×24 frame, captured before the terminal returns to 120×40, still shows the title, the hint, the result line, and the statement. After both frames the cancelled title and hint remain. Ctrl+Y opens Query history and does not list t03_running_marker. Ctrl+W closes history and returns to Query 1 with the cancelled result still shown. Ctrl+Q opens Quit TablePro? for the unsaved query; confirming Quit exits 0.
cases.action_sequence: Start a query, observe running feedback, refuse a second run, and cancel.
cases.expected_results: The cancelled result stays cancelled. A later completion does not replace it.
cases.forbidden_effects: Duplicate run starts a second result.
